events.title: Wild Lights
events.blurb: The Akron Zoo’s evening holiday light display; the Grinch is in his cave 6–8 p.m. Open Friday and Saturday this weekend.
events.blurbEs: El espectáculo nocturno de luces navideñas del Akron Zoo; el Grinch está en su cueva de 6 a 8 p.m. Abierto viernes y sábado este fin de semana.

events.title: The Nutcracker
events.blurb: Ballet Theatre of Ohio’s annual holiday ballet at the 1929 Akron Civic Theatre.
events.blurbEs: El ballet navideño anual del Ballet Theatre of Ohio en el Akron Civic Theatre de 1929.

events.title: A Chanticleer Christmas
events.blurb: The Grammy-winning men’s vocal ensemble’s holiday concert, presented by Tuesday Musical.
events.blurbEs: El concierto navideño del conjunto vocal masculino ganador del Grammy, presentado por Tuesday Musical.

events.title: Akron Zips vs. Buffalo Bulls
events.blurb: Akron Zips football hosts Buffalo in a Black Friday MAC game at InfoCision Stadium-Summa Field.
events.blurbEs: Los Akron Zips reciben a Buffalo en un partido de la MAC el Black Friday en el InfoCision Stadium-Summa Field.

events.title: Cuyahoga Valley National Park
events.blurb: Trails, waterfalls and the towpath in the national park just north of Akron. No entrance fee.
events.blurbEs: Senderos, cascadas y el camino del canal en el parque nacional al norte de Akron. Sin costo de entrada.
